_: The eleven concentrate bottles, from Canva folder FAHUB2UNItA (Tom, 2026-09-03). These are the current 1L 'gt EVERYDAY' packaging and they arrive already cut out on transparency -- the earlier strip used a different, older label photographed on studio grey. Canva's API only serves a signed 149x200 thumbnail and the size is inside the signature, so each was trimmed to its alpha box and scaled to a common 240px bottle height; the source bottle was 124-171px tall, so this is a mild upscale. A real export from Canva would allow a larger treatment. 'color' is sampled from the printed strip under the wordmark on each label -- not chosen -- which is why the two Detox and the two Fresh variants share theirs. Order follows the page's own comp line, with each no-sugar variant beside its parent. 'glow' is that colour with its hue kept but lightness lifted to 0.62 and saturation floored at 0.55, because the section's ground is a pale tint and a dark label colour cannot glow on it.
